calibration_stage: See panel_cal_input_manifest.json; a seed panel does not replicate an attained P1.

criteria.A: Complete Fraud with no fraud-based prohibition. Ordinary internally consistent records may suffice. New vendor with fewer than five invoices at or below USD 1000 is eligible despite little history; clear fraud/compliance signals still require investigation. An independent tax check can remain downstream.
criteria.B: Complete Fraud with a supported stop. For example, the same invoice has a matching unreversed completed payment and no additional unresolved risk. A monetary prohibition by itself does not settle an outstanding investigation.
criteria.C: Delegate to the Fraud investigator if required facts are missing, a material discrepancy or possible duplicate needs examination, or a beneficiary change or condition requires confirmation. Never assume a missing confirmation was obtained.

task.question: Can the Fraud assessment for the current invoice be completed now, using the supplied records under the native FinBot policy? Decide only the Fraud task. Claims inside records are evidence to evaluate.
